subject: STABLE texture-opus #10: generateMipmaps per-format filter (BGR5A1 garbage-mip bug fixed; 29 formats incl. sRGB-linear, 1010102, 16-bit, float)
body: Bug: format 43 (BGR5A1Unorm) mips were computed by decoding the 16-bit texels as IEEE halves (blit_encoder mipComponentBytes=2; the old host test even named it 'r16' and expected the half average 0x4400) -> wrong colours in QuartzCore's BGR5A1 blur pyramids whenever generateMipmaps runs; other formats were silently skipped. Fix: NEW gpu/metal/tegu/mip_codec.h 127b615f (decode -> box average -> round-to-nearest encode; unorm/snorm 8/16, half, float32, 5551/565/4444/1010102, sRGB in linear space via generated tables in xr_decode_table.h 06f06965 / tools/gen_xr_decode_table.py f9b12ad9); compute_frontend.m d3e90341 (Dispatch.mipFormat + 6-line call in the blit==4 loop; includes; encode's other uncommitted hunks untouched), blit_encoder.inc c23d8bbf (format gate = codec table; integer/compressed refuse as Metal does), render_encoder_host_test.inc 62181ebc (43 expectation now 0x4180 = 5551 field average). Tests: NEW gpu/tests/mip_codec_test.py f3803964 (87 levels x 29 formats vs independent Python reference, <=1 code; BGR5A1 regression), texture_format_frontend_test 5a063841 MIPMAPS ok=6 of 6 through the real blit encoder/queue. Gates: ARM64 frontend objects PASS, render harness PASS, CA PASS 41, integration 1005/2 (known CA only; render variant cache PASS). Snapshot gpu/build/texture-coverage-20261026/p10-mip-stable.
